text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of tournament y.
Participate(x, y) ::: x participated in tournament y.
Tie(x, y) ::: x is in a tie on the leaderboard of tournament y.
From(x, z) ::: x is from country z.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of tournament y.
Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participate(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (Tie(x, duMaurier1992) ∧ From(x, belgium)) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
From(descampe, belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participate(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
¬Winner(steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
